description: Every Sunday afternoon we knock doors in 41B, starting from the front parking lot of Park High School (8040 80th St S, Cottage Grove). No experience needed. You'll get a short walkthrough, a partner if you want one, and a list of a few dozen houses. Come for as much of the afternoon as you can.
